line.a_pociag.text: Choo-choo! This is my train. Today it goes through the forest to the lake!

line.a_chce.text: I want to ride! And Owl too!

line.a_bilet.text: First you need a ticket. A ticket costs as many coins as its number shows.

line.a_cztery.text: Your ticket, Bear, costs four coins. Four is a new number - let me show you.

line.a_to_cztery.text: And this is a new number: four.

line.a_zaplac.text: Help Bear pay. Drag four coins onto the plate.

line.a_cztery_monety.text: One, two, three, four. Four coins, just right!

line.a_napisz.text: Write a four on Bear's ticket. Run your finger from the green dot.

line.a_moj_bilet.text: My ticket with a four! I'm going!

line.b_wagony.text: My train has five wagons. Each has its number: one, two, three, four, five.

line.b_bilet2.text: Mouse has a ticket with number two. Point to the wagon she gets into.

line.b_bilet5.text: Bunny has a ticket with number five. Point to his wagon.

line.b_bilet3.text: Hedgehog has a three and knows where to go - into wagon number three!

line.zly_wagon.text: Not that wagon. Look at the number on the ticket.

line.b_odjazd.text: Everyone in their seats? Off we go!

line.c_jablka.text: A stop in the forest! Apple trees and pear trees grow here. Let's pick some fruit for the trip!

line.c_wiecej.text: I have more! Look how long my row is!

line.c_policz.text: A long row isn't more yet. Let's count. Touch Bear's apples one by one.

line.c_piec_misia.text: Five apples. Now count my pears.

line.c_tyle_samo.text: Five too! Five and five are the same, even when they lie far apart.

line.c_rozumiem.text: I see! My row was longer, but there weren't more apples.

line.d_jezioro.text: The lake! End of the trip, everybody off!

line.d_stacja.text: What a lovely stop, right by the lake! The water is sparkling, and look, there's a wooden pier.

line.d_wysiadaja.text: The passengers are getting off the train. Look how they hop onto the platform!

line.d_ilu.text: How many passengers came? Count them, touching each one.

line.p_start.text: Let's practise numbers up to five! I have five games.

line.p_ile.text: How many are there? Count and point to the number.

line.p_bilet5.text: This ticket costs five coins. Drag five coins onto the plate.

line.p_napisz5.text: Write a five with your finger. Start at the green dot.

line.p_kamienie.text: Point to the stone with the number four - I want to jump there.

line.p_kamienie_nie.text: That's not four. Look at the numbers under the stones.

line.p_doskoczylem.text: One, two, three, four! I'm on the four!

line.h_jutro.text: We're home! Tomorrow we go to the lake for a picnic, so we must pack.

line.h_spakuj.text: Now the backpack. Put five things from the windowsill into it. Drag them one at a time, and I'll count.

line.h_za_duzo.text: That's five already! The backpack is full.

line.h_spakowane.text: Five things in the backpack. Ready!

line.h_palce.text: Tomorrow we'll wave to the ducks. How many fingers does this hand have? Count and point to the number.

line.h_palce_nie.text: Count the fingers again, one by one.

line.h_piec_palcow.text: Five fingers! You have five fingers on each hand.

line.h_rodzice.text: Count to five with your parents: five stairs, five spoons, five claps!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for riding with me! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is a wagon from Mole's train. We got it when we counted to five.

line.b_spoznieni.text: Wait! Here come Duckling and Snail. They bought their tickets yesterday!

line.b_bilety_wczoraj.text: Duckling has a one, so it hops into the first wagon.

line.a_znasz.text: One, two, three - you know these numbers already.

line.a_to_piec.text: And this is five. My train has five wagons!

line.b_wsiada2.text: Yes, wagon number two! Hop in, Mouse!

line.b_wsiada5.text: Yes, the five! Jump in, Bunny!

line.b_slimak.text: Snail has a four, but he does not know which wagon that is. Help him: point to wagon number four.

line.b_wsiada4.text: The four! Snail made it, and he thanks you for your help.

line.c_wsiadamy.text: All aboard, on we go - to the lake!

line.c_most.text: We're riding over a high bridge! A river flows far below.

line.c_most2.text: I can see the whole train: the engine and five wagons!

line.d_kaczki.text: Look, a duck is swimming on the lake. I think she's hungry!

line.d_karm_ziarno.text: We have duck food. Drag the food to the duck, let's see what it likes.

line.d_najedzona_ziarno.text: It ate the grain and spat out the pine cone! Pine cones aren't for ducks.

line.d_jutro.text: Now we go home. And tomorrow we'll come back here for a picnic!

line.d_piknik.text: Hooray! Then we must pack today!

line.p_kropki.text: Join the dots in order, from one to five. What will appear?

line.p_lokomotywa.text: My engine! Five dots and there it is.

line.h_jedzenie.text: I'll take apples, and Owl takes sandwiches.

line.h_wiecej.text: I have more food than Owl! Look how long my row is!

line.h_znowu.text: A long row again? Let's check on a chart which there are more of.

line.h_wykres.text: Drag every apple and every sandwich into its own column.

line.h_wykres_nie.text: Apples go with apples, sandwiches with sandwiches.

line.h_rowne.text: The columns are just as tall!

line.h_ile_kolumna.text: How many apples are in the column? Point to the number.

line.h_ile_kolumna_nie.text: Count the apples in the column from the bottom, one by one.

line.h_piec_i_piec.text: Five apples and five sandwiches - the same! A long row is not more.

line.h_piknik.text: And the next day - a picnic by the lake!

line.h_piknik2.text: Five things from the backpack, and we needed every one!

line.h_klaszczemy.text: Let's count to five together and clap five times!

line.h_metka.text: Write a five on the backpack's tag. Then we'll remember there are five things inside.

line.h_metka_ok.text: A five on the tag - just like in the backpack!

line.c_tylko_piec.text: Only five? I thought I had more!
